items.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
items.description: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week.

items.title: Arrest made after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
items.description: Around 200 emergency personnel are deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.

items.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
items.description: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.

items.title: British woman dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in the Bahamas
items.description: The children were subsequently rescued from the water, police say.

items.title: Student movement takes Serbia's Vučić to the wire in neck-and-neck election
items.description: The Student List has emerged from almost two years of anti-corruption protests to form the biggest challenge to Vučić's rule.

items.title: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
items.description: She was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

items.title: Australian MP's condition improves after alleged car attack
items.description: The independent MP is now in a serious but stable condition, according to the Melbourne hospital.

items.title: White House lifts tariffs on some Canadian goods as midterm elections loom
items.description: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on some products, including certain machinery, and placed on others, such as carpets.

items.title: Seven missing after multi-storey building collapses in Kenya's capital
items.description: Rescue efforts are under way to find people trapped under the block, which was still under construction when it buckled.

items.title: Trump administration sues to block certification of upcoming Alaska election
items.description: The justice department has filed a lawsuit arguing that the inclusion of two candidates named Dan Sullivan could confuse voters.

items.title: Minneapolis withdrawal was 'surrender', Trump's ex-border patrol chief tells BBC
items.description: Greg Bovino was the public face of the controversial immigration enforcement operation in the city earlier this year.

items.title: White House says Melania Trump brokered truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
items.description: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.
